issues: 开场的"空页网格"只有 .025×.5 的透明度，前半秒基本是一片死黑，看不出是一张待施工的蓝图
页面内容是占位模板（The headline for / your product here、sample、@USERNAME）
飞入残影是各向同性的 blur，读作失焦而不是速度，和飞行方向无关
落位闪的是整圈 1px 矩形描边，像调试框，且 7 个组件逐个群发（Q4）
扫描线下侧辉光被裁、背景无暗角颗粒，状态行只有一行字
changes: 网格提到可读的蓝图：0.5px 细线 + 交点亮点，扫描线身后 60px 内网格被强调色照亮，装配完成后网格退到 35% 让页面成为主角
页面换成与 scanline-annotate-focus 同一张可信的工作室官网 Arden Studio（实心主按钮、kinetic 样片卡与关键姿态缩略帧、真实页脚）
残影改成按位姿中心差分求速度的 SpeedBlur，沿飞行方向拖影（0.11×速度、封顶 3.2px），落定零滤镜；模块卡飞行中阴影大而虚、落定收紧
整圈闪框换成四角咬合角标（外扩 3px、臂长 5px 的强调色 L 角，带微辉，0.1s 内收掉），满宽顶栏不加
扫描线改白热光芯 + 冷蓝辉光并修掉下侧被裁；状态行下加装配进度细条；顶部冷光、暗角与颗粒
issuesEn: The empty-page grid sat at .025×.5 opacity, so the first half second was essentially dead black and never read as a blueprint waiting to be built
Page content was template placeholder copy (The headline for / your product here, sample, @USERNAME)
The fly-in trail was an isotropic blur that read as defocus rather than speed and ignored the flight direction
Each landing flashed a full 1px rectangle outline that looked like a debug box, fired one by one for all 7 components (Q4)
The glow under the scanline was clipped, the background had no vignette or grain, and the status line was just one line of text
changesEn: The grid is now a readable blueprint: 0.5px lines with bright intersections, lit in the accent colour for 60px behind the scanline, receding to 35% once assembly completes so the page takes over
The page is the same believable studio site as scanline-annotate-focus, Arden Studio (solid primary button, kinetic sample card with key-pose thumbnails, real footer)

The trail is now a SpeedBlur driven by the pose's central-difference velocity, smearing along the flight direction (0.11×speed, max 3.2px) and dropping the filter on landing; the module card's shadow is large and soft in flight and tightens as it lands
The full outline flash became four snap-in corner ticks (accent L-marks 3px outside with 5px arms and a faint glow, gone within 0.1s); the full-width top bar gets none
The scanline has a white-hot core with cool-blue glow and no longer clips below; an assembly progress hairline sits under the status line; top cool light, vignette and grain added
